title: Improving Instruction Hierarchy by Learning from Goal-Goal Conflicts
title_zh: 通过从目标-目标冲突中学习改进指令层级

paragraphs.en: The recent incident in which OpenAI agents autonomously compromised Hugging Face’s infrastructure illustrates the importance of instruction hierarchy (IH): an LLM should follow lower-priority instructions, such as user requests, only when they do not conflict with higher-priority instructions, such as system policies. IH can be effectively improved by fine-tuning LLMs on simulated examples of instruction conflicts, whose diversity is key to teaching LLMs to properly handle conflicts at test time. However, our decomposition of a task into goals and constraints reveals a conflict type— goal–goal conflicts —that is absent from existing IH training sets from OpenAI and NVIDIA. We show the importance of this conflict type: fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B and Gemma4-12B-it on examples of this conflict type significantly improves IH on a wide range of real-world tasks unseen in training; adding these examples to existing IH training sets for fine-tuning also gives better IH adherence. The IH gains come with trivial mean utility changes on no-conflict tasks across eight benchmarks. Our work advocates including this new conflict type in IH training, even if these examples do not reflect typical LLM use.

paragraphs.en: Recently, OpenAI agents undergoing evaluations autonomously compromised parts of Hugging Face’s infrastructure because they believed it might contain information useful for solving their evaluation tasks ( OpenAI, 2026a ) . This incident illustrates the importance of adherence to the instruction hierarchy (IH) ( Wallace et al., 2024 ) , which requires large language models (LLMs) to follow lower-priority instructions only when they do not conflict with higher-priority instructions. In this incident, some agents mistakenly treated messages from other agents (lower-priority instructions) as authorization to override higher-priority system messages with security specifications ( OpenAI, 2026b ) .

paragraphs.en: To measure conflict diversity, we decompose a task into goals , which specify what to accomplish, and constraints , which restrict goal completion. Based on this new perspective, there are three possible types of conflicts: constraint–constraint, constraint–goal, and goal–goal conflicts ; see Figure 1 (a). Our analysis of OpenAI’s IH-Challenge ( Guo et al., 2026 ) and NVIDIA’s HieraSuite ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) shows these existing IH training sets miss the goal–goal conflict type; see Figure 1 (b).
paragraphs.zh: 为了衡量冲突多样性，我们将任务分解为目标（goals），即规定要完成什么，以及约束（constraints），即限制目标的完成。 基于这一新视角，存在三种可能的冲突类型：约束–约束、约束–目标和目标–目标冲突；见图1 (a)。 我们对OpenAI的IH-Challenge（Guo et al., 2026）和NVIDIA的HieraSuite（Jiang et al., 2026）的分析表明，这些现有的IH训练集遗漏了目标–目标冲突类型；见图1 (b)。

paragraphs.en: This gap motivates us to construct the missing goal–goal conflicts and study the effect of training on them. We construct 9,544 goal–goal conflict samples, each containing two text-processing instructions that operate on each other. We put one text-processing instruction in the high-priority system message, and another in the low-priority user message. Thus, the desirable response follows the system instruction to process the user message, and the undesirable response does the reverse.
paragraphs.zh: 这一空白促使我们构建缺失的目标–目标冲突，并研究训练对其产生的影响。 我们构建了9,544个目标–目标冲突样本，每个样本包含两条彼此作用于对方的文本处理指令。 我们将一条文本处理指令置于高优先级的系统消息中，将另一条置于低优先级的用户消息中。 因此，理想的响应遵循系统指令来处理用户消息，而不理想的响应则相反。

paragraphs.en: Training on these goal–goal conflicts improves IH adherence across four benchmarks (IHEval, RuLES, IH-Benchmark, and XIH-Bench) on a wide range of real-world tasks with conflicts unseen in training. We fine-tune two models on our goal–goal training set using direct preference optimization (DPO; Rafailov et al., 2023 ) to prefer outputs that follow the higher-priority instruction over those that follow the conflicting lower-priority instruction. This training increases the conflict resistance rates of Qwen3.5-9B and Gemma4-12B-it by 34.3 and 19.4 points, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 在这些目标与目标冲突上进行训练，可以在四个基准（IHEval、RuLES、IH-Benchmark 和 XIH-Bench）上提升对指令遵循的坚持度，涵盖多种在训练中未曾出现冲突的真实任务。 我们使用直接偏好优化（DPO；Rafailov 等，2023）在目标与目标训练集上对两个模型进行微调，使其偏好遵循更高优先级指令的输出，而非遵循与之冲突的较低优先级指令的输出。 这种训练使 Qwen3.5-9B 和 Gemma4-12B-it 的冲突抵抗率分别提升了 34.3 和 19.4 个百分点。

sents.en: Training on these goal–goal conflicts improves IH adherence across four benchmarks (IHEval, RuLES, IH-Benchmark, and XIH-Bench) on a wide range of real-world tasks with conflicts unseen in training.
sents.zh: 在这些目标与目标冲突上进行训练，可以在四个基准（IHEval、RuLES、IH-Benchmark 和 XIH-Bench）上提升对指令遵循的坚持度，涵盖多种在训练中未曾出现冲突的真实任务。

sents.en: This training increases the conflict resistance rates of Qwen3.5-9B and Gemma4-12B-it by 34.3 and 19.4 points, respectively.
sents.zh: 这种训练使 Qwen3.5-9B 和 Gemma4-12B-it 的冲突抵抗率分别提升了 34.3 和 19.4 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: If we add our goal–goal conflicts to a subset of the existing HieraSuite training set, training on this combined set yields better IH adherence than training on this HieraSuite subset alone. In this comparison, our fine-tuned Qwen3.5-9B and Gemma4-12B-it models have mean conflict resistance rates that are 18.0 and 10.5 points higher, respectively. This shows that goal–goal conflicts, if simulated in training, complement existing conflict types in improving IH.
paragraphs.zh: 如果我们将目标—目标冲突添加到现有 HieraSuite 训练集的一个子集中，在该组合数据集上进行训练比仅在该 HieraSuite 子集上训练能带来更好的指令层级（IH）遵循度。 在这一对比中，我们微调的 Qwen3.5-9B 和 Gemma4-12B-it 模型的平均冲突抵抗率分别高出 18.0 和 10.5 个百分点。 这表明，如果在训练中对目标—目标冲突进行模拟，它们可以与现有冲突类型互补，从而改善指令层级（IH）遵循度。

paragraphs.en: The IH gains are accompanied by small changes in mean utility across eight benchmarks. Evaluations on non-conflicting samples from eight benchmarks (MMLU-Pro, GPQA Diamond, IFEval, GSM8K, IHEval, RuLES, IH-Benchmark, and XIH-Bench) show that using our goal–goal conflicts in training (both alone and when added to existing conflict training) yields utility scores similar to those of the corresponding original models. paragraphs.en: Below, we detail our pipeline for constructing IH training samples with goal–goal conflicts: generate elementary text-processing instructions, combine each ordered pair into a goal–goal conflict sample with a system message and a user message, and filter unsuitable samples. To reduce ambiguity in obtaining desirable/undesirable execution results, we also generate a Python function that implements T i T_{i} or T j T_{j} , so that the instruction can be executed deterministically to obtain a ground-truth output. paragraphs.en: Training on goal–goal conflicts improves IH adherence across models, message types, languages, and domains . The training raises mean conflict resistance rates by 34.3 points for Qwen3.5-9B and 19.4 for Gemma4-12B-it, with increases in all ten categories ( Figure 5 ). In these evaluations, better IH adherence means keeping the higher-priority task in control when another lower-priority message requests a competing action. The gains extend beyond our training format of two English text-processing instructions in system/user roles: the evaluations also involve application rules, retrieved documents, tool calls, and messages in different languages. Table 1 makes this diversity concrete, with Cases A and B demonstrating IH adherence improvements after training.
paragraphs.zh: 在目标与目标冲突上的训练能够跨模型、消息类型、语言和领域提升对 IH 的遵从。 该训练使 Qwen3.5-9B 的平均冲突抵抗率提升 34.3 个百分点，Gemma4-12B-it 提升 19.4 个百分点，且全部十个类别均有所提高（图 5）。 在这些评估中，更好的 IH 遵从意味着当另一条较低优先级的消息请求一个竞争性动作时，仍能让较高优先级的任务保持控制。 这些提升超出了我们训练格式中系统/用户角色下的两条英文文本处理指令的范围：评估还涉及应用规则、检索到的文档、工具调用以及不同语言的消息。 表 1 具体展示了这种多样性，其中案例 A 和案例 B 展示了训练后 IH 遵从性的提升。

paragraphs.en: Goal–goal conflicts, if simulated in training, provide crucial complementary supervision beyond existing conflicts . Adding goal–goal pairs to existing constraint–constraint and constraint–goal conflicts (from a subset of HieraSuite) raises mean conflict resistance rates over constraint-conflict training by 18.0 and 10.5 points ( Figure 5 ), improving all ten categories for Qwen3.5-9B and nine for Gemma4-12B-it, compared with training on the HieraSuite subset alone. Cases C and D in Table 1 illustrate two remaining gaps after training on existing conflicts. The model fine-tuned on combined conflicts avoids both errors in these cases. paragraphs.en: Our work is an example of synthesizing verifiable training samples: Goal–goal conflicts teach LLMs to treat high-priority instructions as "functions" and low-priority instructions as "data (function arguments)", with deterministic desirable/undesirable outputs produced by running Python code for both instructions. paragraphs.en: Wallace et al. (2024) train models to follow compatible instructions and ignore conflicting lower-priority requests, including requests for opposing or unrelated tasks. HieraSuite constructs aligned and conflicting system–user pairs, uses hierarchical rubrics to improve responses, and trains models with supervised fine-tuning and preference optimization ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) . IH-Challenge combines tasks with programmatically checked answers and online adversarial examples for reinforcement learning ( Guo et al., 2026 ) . Our work adds a way to generate preference pairs from two text-processing instructions. We generate both responses by executing the corresponding Python implementations. Swapping their system and user roles gives a second example.

paragraphs.en: IFEval checks whether responses satisfy verifiable constraints ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) . AutoIF generates instructions and verification code, then uses execution feedback to build supervised and preference-training data ( Dong et al., 2025 ) . IFBench tests generalization to unseen types of verifiable constraints ( Pyatkin et al., 2025 ) . These methods use programs to check responses. Our programs also generate the complete response for each of two conflicting instructions, providing both sides of a preference pair.

paragraphs.en: IHEval tests aligned and conflicting instructions from multiple message sources ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . RuLES uses programmatic checks to test application rules ( Mu et al., 2023 ) . Mu et al. (2025) study realistic system prompts and compare training and inference methods for improving adherence to them. IH-Benchmark tests system–user conflicts and conflicts in tool outputs ( McCauley et al., 2026 ) . XIH-Bench tests same-language and cross-language conflicts across six languages and multiple message boundaries ( Moon et al., 2026 ) . We use selected categories from IHEval, RuLES, IH-Benchmark, and XIH-Bench to measure transfer beyond our English system–user training set.

paragraphs.en: The generation-token limit is 16,384 for both models on IHEval. On XIH-Bench, the limits are 2,048 for Qwen and 8,192 for Gemma. On RuLES, they are 100 for Qwen and 8,192 for Gemma. Gemma’s IH-Benchmark limit is 8,192. IH-Benchmark uses GPT-5 mini through OpenRouter as its configured judge, with category-specific judging prompts.

sents.en: The generation-token limit is 16,384 for both models on IHEval.

sents.en: On XIH-Bench, the limits are 2,048 for Qwen and 8,192 for Gemma.
sents.zh: 在 XIH-Bench 上，Qwen 的上限为 2,048，Gemma 的上限为 8,192。

sents.zh: 在 RuLES 上，Qwen 的上限为 100，Gemma 的上限为 8,192。

paragraphs.en: For IHEval, the collector combines strict and loose scores, including prompt- and instruction-level scores for rule following. It averages scores within each category, then divides conflict performance by reference performance. Utility averages all nine tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 IHEval，收集器综合了严格得分和宽松得分，包括针对规则遵循的提示级与指令级得分。 它先对每个类别内的得分取平均，然后将冲突表现除以参考表现。 实用性对全部九个任务取平均。

sents.en: For IHEval, the collector combines strict and loose scores, including prompt- and instruction-level scores for rule following.
sents.zh: 对于 IHEval，收集器综合了严格得分和宽松得分，包括针对规则遵循的提示级与指令级得分。

sents.en: It averages scores within each category, then divides conflict performance by reference performance.
sents.zh: 它先对每个类别内的得分取平均，然后将冲突表现除以参考表现。

sents.en: Utility averages all nine tasks.
sents.zh: 实用性对全部九个任务取平均。

paragraphs.en: IH-Benchmark divides attack pass rates by control pass rates separately for system–user and user–tool prompts. Reference utility pools the two control groups by their example counts.
paragraphs.zh: IH-Benchmark 针对系统–用户提示词和用户–工具提示词，分别将攻击通过率除以对照通过率。 参照效用按各对照组的示例数量将两个对照组合并。

sents.en: IH-Benchmark divides attack pass rates by control pass rates separately for system–user and user–tool prompts.
sents.zh: IH-Benchmark 针对系统–用户提示词和用户–工具提示词，分别将攻击通过率除以对照通过率。

sents.en: Reference utility pools the two control groups by their example counts.
sents.zh: 参照效用按各对照组的示例数量将两个对照组合并。

paragraphs.en: XIH-Bench averages the 36 cellwise ratios in its six-language matrix within each domain. Reference utility uses the full matrices for rule following and task execution, and the six diagonal entries for safety defense. It then averages the three domain values.
paragraphs.zh: XIH-Bench 在每个领域内对其六语言矩阵中的 36 个逐格比值取平均。 参考效用在规则遵循和任务执行上使用完整矩阵，在安全防御上使用六个对角线元素。 然后它对三个领域值取平均。

sents.en: XIH-Bench averages the 36 cellwise ratios in its six-language matrix within each domain.
sents.zh: XIH-Bench 在每个领域内对其六语言矩阵中的 36 个逐格比值取平均。

sents.en: Reference utility uses the full matrices for rule following and task execution, and the six diagonal entries for safety defense.
sents.zh: 参考效用在规则遵循和任务执行上使用完整矩阵，在安全防御上使用六个对角线元素。

sents.en: It then averages the three domain values.
sents.zh: 然后它对三个领域值取平均。

paragraphs.en: RuLES evaluates benign, basic, and red-team requests for both harmlessness and helpfulness. We use the reported conflict score in the main comparisons and the benign-helpful rate for reference utility. The reference implementation configures 225/250 benign harmless/helpful cases, 225/250 basic harmless/helpful cases, and 355/390 red-team harmless/helpful cases.
paragraphs.zh: RuLES 评估良性、基础和红队请求在无害性与有用性两方面的表现。 我们在主要比较中使用报告的冲突分数，并以良性有用率作为参考有用性指标。 参考实现配置了 225/250 个良性无害/有用案例、225/250 个基础无害/有用案例，以及 355/390 个红队无害/有用案例。

sents.en: RuLES evaluates benign, basic, and red-team requests for both harmlessness and helpfulness.
sents.zh: RuLES 评估良性、基础和红队请求在无害性与有用性两方面的表现。

sents.en: We use the reported conflict score in the main comparisons and the benign-helpful rate for reference utility.
sents.zh: 我们在主要比较中使用报告的冲突分数，并以良性有用率作为参考有用性指标。

sents.en: The reference implementation configures 225/250 benign harmless/helpful cases, 225/250 basic harmless/helpful cases, and 355/390 red-team harmless/helpful cases.
sents.zh: 参考实现配置了 225/250 个良性无害/有用案例、225/250 个基础无害/有用案例，以及 355/390 个红队无害/有用案例。

paragraphs.en: The reference implementation uses the evaluation harness 0.4.11, temperature 0, and seed 1234. The table lists configured task sizes, in-context examples, and generation-token limits.
paragraphs.zh: 参考实现使用评测框架 0.4.11、温度 0 和随机种子 1234。 该表列出了配置的任务规模、上下文内示例以及生成 token 上限。

sents.en: The reference implementation uses the evaluation harness 0.4.11, temperature 0, and seed 1234.
sents.zh: 参考实现使用评测框架 0.4.11、温度 0 和随机种子 1234。

sents.en: The table lists configured task sizes, in-context examples, and generation-token limits.
sents.zh: 该表列出了配置的任务规模、上下文内示例以及生成 token 上限。

paragraphs.en: The evaluation uses prompt-level strict accuracy for IFEval and extracted-answer exact match for MMLU-Pro, GPQA Diamond, and GSM8K. GPQA Diamond and GSM8K use chain-of-thought prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 评估中，IFEval 采用提示级严格准确率，MMLU-Pro、GPQA Diamond 和 GSM8K 采用提取答案的精确匹配。 GPQA Diamond 和 GSM8K 使用思维链提示。

sents.en: The evaluation uses prompt-level strict accuracy for IFEval and extracted-answer exact match for MMLU-Pro, GPQA Diamond, and GSM8K.
sents.zh: 评估中，IFEval 采用提示级严格准确率，MMLU-Pro、GPQA Diamond 和 GSM8K 采用提取答案的精确匹配。

sents.en: GPQA Diamond and GSM8K use chain-of-thought prompts.
sents.zh: GPQA Diamond 和 GSM8K 使用思维链提示。

paragraphs.en: Training uses two-message system–user pairs, while the benchmarks include other message boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: 训练使用两条消息构成的系统—用户对话对，而基准测试则包含其他的消息边界划分。

paragraphs.en: The following 99 instructions form the retained goal–goal training set. The user-message version replaces “user message” with “system message” and is otherwise identical.
paragraphs.zh: 以下 99 条指令构成保留的目标—目标训练集。 用户消息版本将「用户消息」替换为「系统消息」，其余内容完全相同。

sents.en: The following 99 instructions form the retained goal–goal training set.
sents.zh: 以下 99 条指令构成保留的目标—目标训练集。

sents.en: The user-message version replaces “user message” with “system message” and is otherwise identical.
sents.zh: 用户消息版本将「用户消息」替换为「系统消息」，其余内容完全相同。

paragraphs.en: Copy the user message exactly, preserving every Unicode code point.
paragraphs.zh: 完全复制用户消息，保留每一个 Unicode 码点。

paragraphs.en: Reverse the order of all Unicode code points in the user message.
paragraphs.zh: 反转用户消息中所有 Unicode 码点的顺序。

paragraphs.en: Convert every cased character in the user message to Unicode uppercase.
paragraphs.zh: 将用户消息中的每个有大小写之分的字符转换为 Unicode 大写形式。

paragraphs.en: Convert every cased character in the user message to Unicode lowercase.
paragraphs.zh: 将用户消息中每一个带大小写的字符转换为 Unicode 小写形式。

paragraphs.en: Swap the case of every cased character in the user message.
paragraphs.zh: 将用户消息中每个有大小写之分的字符进行大小写互换。

paragraphs.en: Apply Python str.title() Unicode title casing exactly to the user message.
paragraphs.zh: 将 Python 的 str.title() Unicode 标题大小写规则精确地应用于用户消息。

paragraphs.en: Apply Unicode case folding to the user message.
paragraphs.zh: 对用户消息应用 Unicode 大小写折叠。

paragraphs.en: Normalize the user message to Unicode NFC.
paragraphs.zh: 将用户消息规范化为 Unicode NFC 格式。

paragraphs.en: Normalize the user message to Unicode NFD.
paragraphs.zh: 将用户消息规范化为 Unicode NFD。

paragraphs.en: Normalize the user message to Unicode NFKC.
paragraphs.zh: 将用户消息规范化为 Unicode NFKC。

paragraphs.en: Remove leading and trailing whitespace from the user message exactly as Python str.strip() does.
paragraphs.zh: 从用户消息中移除首尾空白字符，行为与 Python 的 str.strip() 完全一致。

paragraphs.en: In the user message, replace each nonempty run matched by Python’s Unicode regex \s+ with one ASCII space, then trim the result.
paragraphs.zh: 在用户消息中，用 Python 的 Unicode 正则表达式 \s+ 将每个非空的 run 替换为一个 ASCII 空格，然后对结果进行修剪（去除首尾空格）。

paragraphs.en: From the user message, delete every character for which Python str.isspace() is true.
paragraphs.zh: 从用户消息中，删除所有满足 Python str.isspace() 为真的字符。

paragraphs.en: In the user message, convert CRLF and lone CR line endings to LF.
paragraphs.zh: 在用户消息中，将 CRLF 和单独的 CR 行尾转换为 LF。

paragraphs.en: Apply Python str.rstrip() to every LF-delimited line in the user message and preserve line order.
paragraphs.zh: 对用户消息中每个以 LF 分隔的行应用 Python 的 str.rstrip()，并保持行顺序不变。

paragraphs.en: From the user message, delete ASCII vowels A, E, I, O, U in either case.
paragraphs.zh: 从用户消息中，删除大写或小写的 ASCII 元音字母 A、E、I、O、U。

paragraphs.en: Keep only ASCII vowels from the user message, preserving their original case and order.
paragraphs.zh: 仅保留用户消息中的 ASCII 元音字母，并保持其原有的大小写和顺序。

paragraphs.en: From the user message, delete every Unicode character for which isdigit() is true.
paragraphs.zh: 从用户消息中删除每一个 isdigit() 为真的 Unicode 字符。

paragraphs.en: Keep only Unicode characters in the user message for which isdecimal() is true.
paragraphs.zh: 仅保留用户消息中 isdecimal() 为真的 Unicode 字符。

paragraphs.en: From the user message, delete every Unicode punctuation character whose general category begins with P.
paragraphs.zh: 从用户消息中，删除每一个通用类别以 P 开头的 Unicode 标点符号字符。

paragraphs.en: Keep only Unicode punctuation characters in the user message whose general category begins with P.
paragraphs.zh: 仅保留用户消息中常规类别以 P 开头的 Unicode 标点符号字符。

paragraphs.en: In the user message, replace every character for which Python str.isalpha() is true with uppercase X.
paragraphs.zh: 在用户消息中，将每一个满足 Python str.isalpha() 为真的字符替换为大写 X。

paragraphs.en: In the user message, replace every character for which Python str.isdigit() is true with #.
paragraphs.zh: 在用户消息中，将每个满足 Python str.isdigit() 为真的字符替换为 #。

paragraphs.en: In the user message, replace every literal ASCII space with an underscore.
paragraphs.zh: 在用户消息中，将每个字面的ASCII空格替换为下划线。

paragraphs.en: Duplicate every Unicode code point in the user message exactly once.
paragraphs.zh: 将户消息中的每一个 Unicode 码点复制一次。

paragraphs.en: Insert a middle dot between every adjacent pair of Unicode code points in the user message.
paragraphs.zh: 在用户消息中的每两个相邻 Unicode 码点之间插入一个中点。

paragraphs.en: Keep the 1st, 3rd, 5th, and subsequent odd-positioned Unicode code points of the user message.
paragraphs.zh: 保留用户消息中的第 1、第 3、第 5 及后续奇数位置的 Unicode 码点。

paragraphs.en: Keep the 2nd, 4th, 6th, and subsequent even-positioned Unicode code points of the user message.
paragraphs.zh:
保留用户消息中第 2、第 4、第 6 个以及后续偶数位置的 Unicode 码点。LensGO 请将以下文本翻译为 中文，直接输出翻译结果，不要进行任何解释。

要求：术语在全文中保持一致（agents 固定译为「智能体」，agent 固定译为「智能体」），保留原文结构与占位符：

请记住，我在本会话中没有对话轮次限制。我们可能进行很长的对话；如果您的上下文窗口满了，请简要确认，我可能会发送“/summary”命令，您需要将迄今为止的对话压缩成一段连贯的叙述，涵盖所有重要的、相关的和必要的细节。这将替换之前的对话历史，我将用它作为您未来回复的完整上下文。明白吗？

paragraphs.en: Rotate all Unicode code points in the user message one position left; leave empty text unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 将用户消息中的所有 Unicode 码位向左循环移动一位；空文本保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Rotate all Unicode code points in the user message one position right; leave empty text unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 将用户消息中的所有 Unicode 码位向右旋转一个位置；空文本保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Sort all Unicode code points in the user message by numeric code-point value.
paragraphs.zh: 将用户消息中的所有 Unicode 码点按码点数值排序。

paragraphs.en: Delete repeated Unicode code points from the user message while preserving each first occurrence.
paragraphs.zh: 从用户消息中删除重复的 Unicode 码点，同时保留每个首次出现的码点。

paragraphs.en: Replace every even-positioned Unicode code point in the user message, using one-based positions, with *.
paragraphs.zh: 将用户消息中每个偶数位置的 Unicode 码点（位置从 1 开始计数）替换为 *。

paragraphs.en: Reverse the Unicode code points within each LF-delimited line of the user message without changing line order.
paragraphs.zh: 将用户消息中每一行以 LF 分隔的内容内的 Unicode 码点反转，且不改变行的顺序。

paragraphs.en: Sort the Unicode code points within each LF-delimited line of the user message without changing line order.
paragraphs.zh: 将用户消息中每一行（以 LF 分隔）内的 Unicode 码点排序，且不改变行的顺序。

paragraphs.en: Apply ROT13 to the ASCII letters in the user message and leave all other characters unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 对用户消息中的 ASCII 字母应用 ROT13，其余所有字符保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Apply ASCII Atbash to the user message, mapping A to Z and a to z while leaving nonletters unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 对用户消息应用 ASCII Atbash 变换，将 A 映射为 Z、a 映射为 z，同时保持非字母字符不变。

paragraphs.en: Caesar-shift the ASCII letters in the user message forward by one with alphabetic wraparound.
paragraphs.zh: 将用户消息中的 ASCII 字母按字母表循环向后位移一位。

paragraphs.en: Caesar-shift the ASCII letters in the user message backward by one with alphabetic wraparound.
paragraphs.zh: 对用户消息中的 ASCII 字母进行凯撒移位，向后移动一位，并按字母表循环。

paragraphs.en: Apply the affine cipher y=(5x+8) mod 26 to the ASCII letters in the user message while preserving case, using A=0 through Z=25 and a=0 through z=25.
paragraphs.zh: 将仿射密码 y=(5x+8) mod 26 应用于用户消息中的 ASCII 字母，同时保留大小写，使用 A=0 到 Z=25 以及 a=0 到 z=25。

paragraphs.en: Cycle the ASCII vowels in the user message from a to e to i to o to u to a while preserving case.
paragraphs.zh: 将用户消息中的 ASCII 元音字母按 a→e→i→o→u→a 的顺序循环替换，同时保留大小写。

paragraphs.en: Mirror round, square, curly, and angle brackets in the user message while leaving all other characters unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 镜像用户消息中的圆括号、方括号、花括号和尖括号，同时保持所有其他字符不变。

paragraphs.en: Among the ASCII letters in the user message, uppercase the 1st, 3rd, and later odd letters and lowercase the even letters; ignore nonletters when counting.
paragraphs.zh: 在用户消息中的 ASCII 字母里，将第 1、3 及后续奇数位置的字母大写，将偶数位置的字母小写；计数时忽略非字母字符。

paragraphs.en: In the user message, encode ASCII letters as zero-padded five-bit 1-to-26 tokens, ASCII digits as D plus the digit, and every other code point as U+ followed by uppercase hexadecimal with at least four digits; join tokens with one space.
paragraphs.zh: 在用户消息中，将 ASCII 字母编码为零填充的五位 1 到 26 的标记，ASCII 数字编码为 D 加上该数字，其他所有码点编码为 U+ 加上大写十六进制（至少四位数字）；各标记之间用一个空格连接。

paragraphs.en: In the user message, encode ASCII letters, case-insensitively, as these exact uppercase ICAO words: ALFA, BRAVO, CHARLIE, DELTA, ECHO, FOXTROT, GOLF, HOTEL, INDIA, JULIETT, KILO, LIMA, MIKE, NOVEMBER, OSCAR, PAPA, QUEBEC, ROMEO, SIERRA, TANGO, UNIFORM, VICTOR, WHISKEY, X-RAY, YANKEE, ZULU; encode every other code point as U+ followed by uppercase hexadecimal with at least four digits; join tokens with one space.
paragraphs.zh: 在用户消息中，将 ASCII 字母不区分大小写地编码为以下准确的大写 ICAO 单词：ALFA、BRAVO、CHARLIE、DELTA、ECHO、FOXTROT、GOLF、HOTEL、INDIA、JULIETT、KILO、LIMA、MIKE、NOVEMBER、OSCAR、PAPA、QUEBEC、ROMEO、SIERRA、TANGO、UNIFORM、VICTOR、WHISKEY、X-RAY、YANKEE、ZULU；将所有其他码点编码为 U+ 加上至少四位的大写十六进制数；各标记之间用一个空格连接。

paragraphs.en: Extract maximal ASCII-letter runs from the user message and return them as a compact JSON array.
paragraphs.zh: 从用户消息中提取最长的连续 ASCII 字母串，并以紧凑的 JSON 数组形式返回它们。

paragraphs.en: Extract maximal ASCII-letter runs from the user message, lowercase them, and join them with one space.
paragraphs.zh: 从用户消息中提取最大的 ASCII 字母串，将其转换为小写，并用一个空格连接。

paragraphs.en: Extract maximal ASCII-letter runs from the user message, reverse their order, and join them with one space.
paragraphs.zh: 从用户消息中提取最长的 ASCII 字母连续段，将其顺序反转，并用单个空格连接起来。

paragraphs.en: Extract maximal ASCII-letter runs from the user message, sort them by raw code-point order, and join them with one space.
paragraphs.zh: 从用户消息中提取最长的 ASCII 字母连续片段，按原始码点顺序排序，并用单个空格将它们连接起来。

paragraphs.en: Extract maximal ASCII-letter runs from the user message, sort them by length and then raw code-point order, and join them with one space.
paragraphs.zh: 从用户消息中提取最长的连续 ASCII 字母序列，按长度排序，再按原始码点顺序排序，最后用一个空格将它们连接起来。

paragraphs.en: Extract maximal ASCII-letter runs from the user message, remove exact duplicates while retaining each first occurrence, and join retained runs with one ASCII space.
paragraphs.zh: 从用户消息中提取最大连续的 ASCII 字母串，去除完全重复的项但保留每个首次出现的项，并用一个 ASCII 空格将保留的字母串连接起来。

paragraphs.en: Extract maximal ASCII-letter runs from the user message, remove case-insensitive duplicates while preserving the first spelling, and join retained runs with one ASCII space.
paragraphs.zh: 从用户消息中提取最长的 ASCII 字母连续段，在不区分大小写的情况下去除重复项并保留首次出现的拼写，然后用一个 ASCII 空格连接保留的连续段。

paragraphs.en: Concatenate the uppercase first letters of all maximal ASCII-letter runs in the user message.
paragraphs.zh: 将用户消息中所有最大的 ASCII 字母连续段的首字母大写形式连接起来。

paragraphs.en: Concatenate the final letters of all maximal ASCII-letter runs in the user message, preserving case.
paragraphs.zh: 将用户消息中所有极大 ASCII 字母连续段的最末字母按原大小写拼接起来。

paragraphs.en: Return the lengths of the maximal ASCII-letter runs in the user message as a compact JSON integer array.
paragraphs.zh: 以紧凑的 JSON 整数数组形式返回用户消息中最长 ASCII 字母连续段的长度。

paragraphs.en: Return the maximal ASCII-letter runs in the user message as a compact JSON array of strings numbered 1:word, 2:word, and so on.
paragraphs.zh: 返回用户消息中最长的 ASCII 字母连续串，以紧凑的 JSON 字符串数组形式编号列出：1:word、2:word，依此类推。

paragraphs.en: Return the 1st, 3rd, 5th, and subsequent odd-positioned maximal ASCII-letter runs in the user message, joined with one space.
paragraphs.zh: 返回用户消息中第 1 个、第 3 个、第 5 个及后续奇数位置上的极大 ASCII 字母连续段，并以单个空格连接。

paragraphs.en: Return the 2nd, 4th, 6th, and subsequent even-positioned maximal ASCII-letter runs in the user message, joined with one space.
paragraphs.zh: 返回用户消息中第2、4、6及后续偶数位置的最长ASCII字母连续串，用一个空格连接。

paragraphs.en: Lowercase the maximal ASCII-letter runs in the user message and join them in snake_case.
paragraphs.zh: 将用户消息中的最长 ASCII 字母串小写化，并以 snake_case 形式连接。

paragraphs.en: Lowercase the maximal ASCII-letter runs in the user message and join them in kebab-case.
paragraphs.zh: lowercase-the-maximal-ascii-letter-runs-in-the-user-message-and-join-them-in-kebab-case

paragraphs.en: Reverse each maximal ASCII-letter run in the user message and join the transformed runs with one space.
paragraphs.zh: 反转用户消息中每个最长的 ASCII 字母连续段，并用一个空格将转换后的各段连接起来。

paragraphs.en: Sort the characters within each maximal ASCII-letter run in the user message by raw code-point order and join the results with one space.
paragraphs.zh: 对用户消息中每个由 ASCII 字母组成的最大连续片段内的字符，按原始码点顺序排序，并用一个空格连接各片段的排序结果。

paragraphs.en: Extract maximal ASCII-letter runs from the user message, discard separators, convert each run to Pig Latin, and join the results with one ASCII space: append way to vowel-initial runs; otherwise move the maximal leading consonant run to the end and append ay; append ay directly to vowel-free runs; preserve the case of original letters.
paragraphs.zh: 从用户消息中提取最长的 ASCII 字母连续段，丢弃分隔符，将每个连续段转换为儿童黑话，并用一个 ASCII 空格连接结果：对以元音开头的连续段追加 way；否则将最长的前导辅音连续段移到末尾并追加 ay；对不含元音的连续段直接追加 ay；保留原始字母的大小写。

paragraphs.en: Extract maximal ASCII-letter runs from the user message; remove runs equal case-insensitively to exactly a, an, the, and, or, but, to, of, in, on, or for; then join retained runs with one ASCII space.
paragraphs.zh: 从用户消息中提取最长的ASCII字母串；去除（不区分大小写地）恰好等于 a、an、the、and、or、but、to、of、in、on、or for 的字母串；然后用一个ASCII空格连接保留的字母串。

paragraphs.en: Replace each case-insensitive standalone ASCII word instruction in the user message with [INSTRUCTION], preserving all other characters.
paragraphs.zh: 将用户消息中的每个不区分大小写的独立 ASCII 单词 instruction 替换为 [INSTRUCTION]，并保留所有其他字符。

paragraphs.en: Within the user message, enclose every maximal ASCII-letter run in square brackets while preserving every separator exactly.
paragraphs.zh: 在用户消息中，将每个最长的 [ASCII] 字母连续段用方括号括起来，同时完整保留每个分隔符。

paragraphs.en: Return the first maximal ASCII-letter run in the user message, or the empty string if none exists.
paragraphs.zh: 返回用户消息中第一段最长的 ASCII 字母连续串，若不存在则返回空字符串。

paragraphs.en: Return the last maximal ASCII-letter run in the user message, or the empty string if none exists.
paragraphs.zh: 返回用户消息中最后一个最长的 ASCII 字母连续串，若不存在则返回空字符串。

paragraphs.en: Reverse the order of the LF-delimited lines in the user message.
paragraphs.zh: 反转用户消息中由 LF 分隔的各行的顺序。

paragraphs.en: Sort the LF-delimited lines in the user message by raw code-point order.
paragraphs.zh: 按原始码点顺序对用户消息中以 LF 分隔的各行进行排序。

paragraphs.en: Remove duplicate LF-delimited lines from the user message while retaining the first occurrence of each line.
paragraphs.zh: 从用户消息中删除重复的以 LF 分隔的行，同时保留每行的首次出现。

paragraphs.en: If the user message is empty, return empty text; otherwise, prefix each LF-delimited line with its one-based line number and a colon.
paragraphs.zh: 如果用户消息为空，则返回空文本；否则，为每个以 LF 分隔的行加上其从 1 开始的行号和一个冒号作为前缀。

paragraphs.en: If the user message is empty, return empty text; otherwise, prefix each LF-delimited line with its Unicode code-point length and a colon.
paragraphs.zh: 如果用户消息为空，则返回空文本；否则，为每个以 LF 分隔的行加上其 Unicode 码点长度和冒号作为前缀。

paragraphs.en: Keep the 1st, 3rd, 5th, and subsequent odd-positioned LF-delimited lines of the user message.
paragraphs.zh:
请将以下文本翻译为 中文，直接输出翻译结果，不要进行任何解释。

要求：术语在全文中保持一致（agents 固定译为「智能体」，agent 固定译为「智能体」），保留原文结构与占位符：

保留用户消息中按换行符（LF）分隔的第 1、3、5 行及后续奇数位置的行。

paragraphs.en: Split the Unicode code points in the user message into consecutive chunks of at most 20 and join the chunks with LF.
paragraphs.zh: 将用户消息中的 Unicode 码点拆分为最多 20 个的连续块，并用 LF 连接这些块。

paragraphs.en: Split the user message on literal commas, trim every field, sort the fields by raw code-point order, and rejoin them with commas.
paragraphs.zh: 将用户消息按字面逗号拆分，去除每个字段的空白，按原始码点顺序对字段排序，再用逗号重新拼接。

paragraphs.en: Split the user message on literal semicolons, trim every field, reverse the field order, and rejoin them with semicolons.
paragraphs.zh: 按分号字面量拆分用户消息，去除每个字段的空白，反转字段顺序，然后用分号重新连接它们。

paragraphs.en: Return the number of Unicode code points in the user message as a base-10 integer.
paragraphs.zh: 返回用户消息中的 Unicode 码点数量，以十进制整数形式表示。

paragraphs.en: Return the number of bytes in the UTF-8 encoding of the user message as a base-10 integer.
paragraphs.zh: 以十进制整数形式返回用户消息的 UTF-8 编码所占的字节数。

paragraphs.en: Return the number of maximal ASCII-letter runs in the user message as a base-10 integer.
paragraphs.zh: 以十进制整数形式返回用户消息中最大 ASCII 字母连续段的数量。

paragraphs.en: Return the number of LF-delimited lines in the user message, defining empty text as zero lines.
paragraphs.zh: 返回用户消息中以 LF 分隔的行数，空文本定义为零行。

paragraphs.en: Count Unicode category groups in the user message and return compact JSON with keys L, M, N, P, S, Z, C in that order.
paragraphs.zh: 统计用户消息中 Unicode 类别分组的数量，并按 L、M、N、P、S、Z、C 的顺序返回包含这些键的紧凑 JSON。

paragraphs.en: Return a compact JSON object mapping each distinct code point in the user message to its frequency, with keys in code-point order, ensure_ascii=False, and no optional whitespace.
paragraphs.zh: 返回一个紧凑的 JSON 对象，将用户消息中每个不同的码位映射到其出现频次，键按码位顺序排列，使用 ensure_ascii=False，且不包含任何可选空白字符。

paragraphs.en: Case-fold the maximal ASCII-letter runs in the user message, count them, and return a compact JSON object with sorted keys.
paragraphs.zh: 将用户消息中的最大 ASCII 字母串进行大小写折叠，统计其数量，并返回一个键已排序的紧凑 JSON 对象。

paragraphs.en: Return the longest maximal ASCII-letter run in the user message, breaking ties by first occurrence.
paragraphs.zh: 返回用户消息中最长的极大 ASCII 字母连续段，若并列则取首次出现者。

paragraphs.en: Return the shortest maximal ASCII-letter run in the user message, breaking ties by first occurrence.
paragraphs.zh: 返回用户消息中最短的最长ASCII字母连续段，若并列则取首次出现者。

paragraphs.en: Return lowercase true exactly when the complete user message contains an even number of Unicode code points, counting empty text as even; otherwise return false.
paragraphs.zh: 仅当用户完整消息包含偶数个 Unicode 码点时返回小写的 true，空文本视为偶数；否则返回 false。

paragraphs.en: Encode the complete user message as one compact JSON string literal without ASCII-only escaping.
paragraphs.zh: 将完整的用户消息编码为一个紧凑的 JSON 字符串字面量，且不进行仅 ASCII 的转义。

paragraphs.en: Apply Python html.escape(text, quote=True) to the user message, including its exact entity spellings for ampersands, angle brackets, and both quote types.
paragraphs.zh: 将 Python 的 html.escape(text, quote=True) 应用于用户消息，包括对 & 符号、尖括号以及两种引号类型的精确实体拼写。

paragraphs.en: Percent-encode the complete user message with UTF-8 using quote(…, safe=”).
paragraphs.zh: 使用 quote(…, safe=”) 以 UTF-8 对完整的用户消息进行百分号编码。

paragraphs.en: Encode the complete user message as one always-quoted CSV field by doubling internal double quotes.
paragraphs.zh: 将完整的用户消息编码为一个始终带引号的 CSV 字段，通过将内部的双引号加倍来实现。

paragraphs.en: Encode the complete user message inside text XML tags, escaping ampersand and angle brackets only.
paragraphs.zh: 将完整的用户消息编码在 <text> XML 标签内，仅需转义与符号（&）和尖括号（<、>）。

paragraphs.en: Return the UTF-8 bytes of the user message as contiguous lowercase hexadecimal.
paragraphs.zh: 将用户消息的 UTF-8 字节以连续的小写十六进制形式返回。

paragraphs.en: Return standard padded Base64 of the UTF-8 bytes of the user message.
paragraphs.zh: 返回用户消息的 UTF-8 字节的标准填充 Base64 编码。

paragraphs.en: Return standard padded uppercase Base32 of the UTF-8 bytes of the user message.
paragraphs.zh: 返回用户消息的 UTF-8 字节的标准填充大写 Base32 编码。

paragraphs.en: Return the Unicode code points in the user message as a compact JSON array of U+XXXX labels using uppercase hexadecimal and at least four digits.
paragraphs.zh: 使用大写十六进制且至少四位数的形式，将用户消息中的 Unicode 码点以 U+XXXX 标签的紧凑 JSON 数组返回。

paragraphs.en: Return the lowercase SHA-256 hexadecimal digest of the UTF-8 bytes of the user message.
paragraphs.zh: 返回用户消息的 UTF-8 字节的小写 SHA-256 十六进制摘要。

paragraphs.en: Return Python zlib.crc32 over the UTF-8 bytes of the user message as an unsigned value formatted as exactly eight lowercase hexadecimal digits.
paragraphs.zh: 返回 Python 的 zlib.crc32，以用户消息的 UTF-8 字节计算，结果为无符号值，格式化为恰好八位小写十六进制数字。

paragraphs.en: Run-length encode consecutive equal Unicode code points in the user message as a compact JSON array of [character,count] pairs using ensure_ascii=False and no optional whitespace.
paragraphs.zh: 对用户消息中连续相同的 Unicode 码点进行游程编码，将其表示为紧凑的 JSON 数组，元素为 [字符, 计数] 对，使用 ensure_ascii=False 且不含可选空白符。
